thread:
Sophie: Quick thread — I sketched a compact "signal mapper" slide that overlays latency vs $/token for 3 customer slices (consumer app, SMB autopilot, enterprise compliance). Need copy + chart style. Aim: single slide for webinar + 1 social post visual. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Mike: Love the idea. Can we make the axes units intuitive for non-ML folks? e.g., 'p95 latency (ms)' x-axis and 'cost per 1k responses (USD)' y-axis.

Elaine: Agree on axis labels. For the visual, propose: scatter plot with three clusters (slices), plus a dashed iso-cost curve to show tradeoffs. Add small callouts with recommended levers (batching, quantization, routing) per cluster.

Jordana: Copy suggestions for top-of-slide headline: "Match latency expectations to unit economics — choose the right serving knobs". Subhead: "How small changes in batch, cache, and model variant move cost and latency for different workloads."

Mike: For social post we need a simplified chart: 2-panel image. Left = low-latency corridor (consumer chat) with a short blurb. Right = throughput-econ (batching + cheaper model) with CTA to webinar.

Sophie: I'm attaching the quick data sample used for the sketch. Use this for plotting:```
cluster,median_p95_ms,cost_per_1k
consumer,120,1.75
smb,350,0.9
enterprise,420,2.8
```
Keep marker sizes proportional to QPS.

BenchBot: automated note: pinned chart template "scatter-iso" in /figma/benchmarks (shared link) — https://figma.com/file/bench-scatter-template

Elaine: Language for CTAs: webinar RSVP: "See the real tradeoffs — live demo of batch, cache, and fallback policies." Social CTA short: "How much does latency really cost? Join our webinar."

Jordana: Routing note for inbound leads: tag registrants by selection in RSVP form ("I care about: latency / cost / compliance") -> auto-route: latency -> growth; cost -> solutions; compliance -> AE. Add UTM param for enterprise follow-up.

Sophie: Nice. One more ask — for the slide notes, include a 2-sentence explanation for each lever: batching increases throughput but raises p95; cache reduces cost for repeated prefixes; model variants degrade quality slightly but cut cost. Keep it non-technical.

Mike: I'll mock the two-panel social image and the scatter slide today. Elaine, can you finalize CTAs? Jordana, will you add the routing fields to the RSVP form?

Elaine: Yep, CTAs drafted — will drop copy in the doc by 4pm.

Jordana: Adding fields now, will share test RSVP link when ready.

Sophie: Perfect — thanks team. I'll update the figma and tag you all. :thumbsup:
